chain_fees_1y.label: Chain fee revenue, trailing 12m
chain_fees_1y.method: DefiLlama total1y for the NEAR chain fee feed

chain_fees_30d.label: Chain fees, last 30d
chain_fees_30d.method: sum of the last 30 daily fee points

chain_fees_prev_30d.label: Chain fees, prior 30d
chain_fees_prev_30d.method: sum of the 30 daily fee points before that

intents_volume_1y.label: Intents settlement volume, trailing 12m
intents_volume_1y.method: DefiLlama total1y for NEAR Intents (dex volume feed)

intents_volume_30d.label: Intents volume, last 30d
intents_volume_30d.method: sum of the last 30 daily volume points

intents_volume_prev_30d.label: Intents volume, prior 30d
intents_volume_prev_30d.method: sum of the 30 daily volume points before that

take_rate_bps.label: Take rate on settled volume
take_rate_bps.method: chain fees ÷ Intents volume × 10,000 (an upper bound: some fees come from non-Intents activity)

near_price.label: NEAR price
near_price.method: spot price reported by NEAR Blocks

tvl_trend_90d.label: TVL trend, 90d average vs prior 90d
tvl_trend_90d.method: (mean of last 90 days − mean of prior 90 days) ÷ prior mean

tvl_rank.label: TVL rank among chains
tvl_rank.method: position among all chains ranked by TVL

stable_trend_90d.label: Stablecoin trend, 90d average vs prior 90d
stable_trend_90d.method: (mean of last 90 days − mean of prior 90 days) ÷ prior mean

top10_stake_pct.label: Top-10 validator share of stake
top10_stake_pct.method: sum of the 10 largest stakes ÷ total stake

commits_30d.label: nearcore commits, last 30d
commits_30d.method: count of commits returned for the last 30 days (API page size caps this at 100, so read it as a floor)

fee_rank.label: Rank among chains by annual fees
fee_rank.method: position among chains ranked by trailing 12m fees

solana_fees_1y.label: Solana chain fees, trailing 12m
solana_fees_1y.method: DefiLlama total1y for Solana, used as a scale reference

hashBasis: sha256 of canonical JSON over { chain, metrics, sources }
